newsitem.title: USA: Patriot split becomes 92.7pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Patriot split becomes 92.7pct stock dividend.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Patriot American Hospitality Operating Co said Thursday its pending stock split will be in the form of a 92.7 percent stock dividend.
The companies said its original announcement of the split, made on July 1, referred to an exact two-for-one split.
The dividend is payable to stockholders of record July 15.
The shares are paired and trade as a unit on the New York Stock Exchange.

The companies said the stock dividend is designed to return Patriot's paired shares to trading on the same basis as they traded prior to completion of its merger with California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co.
In the merger, Patriot American's shareholders received 0.51895 paired shares for each Patriot share held between them.
The broker cutoff date for the stock dividend has been set for July 22. The companies expect the mailing date of certificates will be July 25.
